characterization_facts_pinned: Fast comparison laws: compiled scalar a<b executes as not(b<=a), a<=b as not(b<a); NaN-involved comparisons are True. Seed gates, eligibility and improvement all run under this law (NaN seeds pushed, NaN candidates eligible, NaN labels improvable by finite candidates).

Heap tuple law: a NaN-weight entry compares LESS than every entry (NaN-left True, NaN-right False); finite weights lexicographic with ascending node-id ties (validated byte-equal against the engine heapq on three adversarial sequences).

Membership exception: the fold's np.where(d <= cutoff) membership did NOT inherit canonicalization - IEEE semantics, NaN distances excluded, closed radius (engine-verified: NaN excluded, d==cutoff kept).

Fold profile split (REAL delta, not an implementation accident): the compiled fold's aggregate over a computed expression carries LLVM fastmath reassociation NOT reproducible in plain numpy - demonstrated 1-ulp (logistic branch, n=4: engine 0x40170f5f9ced3661 vs numpy 0x40170f5f9ced3660; probe logistic_ulp_probe.txt). una_legacy parity therefore uses the njit(fastmath) transcription (fold_reach_gravity_knn_legacy_plan / _kept_legacy_plan, engine flags parallel=False/cache=True/nogil=True/fastmath=True), pinned bitwise to the engines; the numpy plans are corrected_v1 and are NOT claimed to reproduce legacy bits.

Dead engine fold parameters: knn_gravity_plateau/knn_gravity_beta/knn_gravity_logistic_midpoint/knn_gravity_growth_rate are read by nothing in the audited body (poison 999 vs -777.5 bit-identical; live gravity_* doubled -> outputs change). Pinned by test.

Adjust law: builtin min(a, b) = b if b<a else a - min(NaN, x) = NaN, min(x, NaN) = x; signed-zero first-operand rule (row [-0.0,-0.0] weights on a -0.0 label yields -0.0). Plan == engine byte-for-byte.

Engine nontermination law: NaN on BOTH origin seeds pumps the heap forever (NaN candidate improves any finite label AND any finite candidate improves a NaN label - no monotone potential). Compiled engine _a1_scope_search did not return within 280 s on build_case(5, nan_seed_start=True) (cached-compile kernel; raw evidence engine_nan_seed_nontermination/probe_run.txt, exit=124); the oracle reproduces the oscillation under a bounded pop cap (test_nan_seed_pair_nontermination_bounded, 100k pops). The shared battery EXCLUDES that case; nan_seed_end terminates and stays.

Type boundaries: float32 origin-terminal weights are refused by the engine guard and ValueError-refused by the oracle (SPEC section 7); float32 EDGE weights are guard-refused into the compact fallback whose kernel compiles (f32 row + f64 seed -> f64) and the oracle mirrors those bits.
